tuition.note: Albany, Bartlett, Eaton, Freedom, Jackson, Madison and Tamworth pay the Conway School District tuition for Kennett (and some for grades K-8), and Hart's Location pays Bartlett for grades K-6 (SAU 9 tuition contracts). Those payments sit in both the paying district's budget and the receiving district's budget. The 2026-27 tuition amounts are in each district's detailed budget (MS-26) or Conway's revenue estimate (MS-24), which SAU 9 and SAU 13 do not post online, so they are not subtracted yet.

source.label: SAU 9, Tuition Agreement Overview
